question: Will at least one film surpass US$1 billion in worldwide box office before May 1, 2026?
summary: The strongest objection notes that the milestone may have effectively occurred within the window; evidence shows Avatar: Fire and Ash crossed $1B worldwide in early January 2026, making the event effectively certain by May 1, 2026.
Objections about reliance on high-profile outliers and potential data/ definitional issues exist, but they do not negate the observed milestone and thus do not justify lowering the forecast.

Historical and current trends (expanding 1B club, non-English titles joining, and sustained yearly occurrences) support a high base-rate likelihood that at least one film will exceed $1B before May 1, 2026.
Given the new information, I raised the probability slightly from the ensemble 98% to 99%, reflecting an updated near-certainty in the forecast window.

justification.critique_assessment: Objections about the milestone having already occurred are valid and point to a near-certain outcome within the window; data definitional concerns exist but do not undermine the observed milestone.
justification.adjustment: Adjusted upward from 0.98 to 0.99 to reflect the observed milestone breach within the forecast window; no downward adjustment was applied.

forecasts.reference-class: Billion-Dollar Club: all films worldwide that have grossed $1 billion or more (worldwide box office), including Hollywood and non-English releases.

sources.claim: As of August 2023, 53 films had worldwide grosses over $1 billion; Barbie was the latest to join the club.
In 2025, Zootopia 2 became the year's second Hollywood title to surpass $1 billion worldwide, and Lilo & Stitch also crossed $1 billion.
Ne Zha 2 crossed $2.26 billion worldwide, illustrating continued growth of the $1B club into non-English-language cinema.
Avatar: Fire and Ash crossed $1 billion at the worldwide box office in 2025.
The Wrap lists all films that have grossed over $1 billion worldwide; as of 2023 the club included 53 titles.
AP News reports that in 2025 multiple films crossed $1B worldwide, including Lilo & Stitch and Zootopia 2, with Avatar: Fire and Ash joining the club.
AP News confirms Zootopia 2 surpassed about $1.14B in 2025, the second 1B film of the year after Lilo & Stitch.
As of January 2026, about 59 films have crossed $1B; Avatar: Fire & Ash is the latest to join the club.
The Numbers maintains an all-time worldwide box-office list that includes numerous $1B+ titles and tracks cumulative records.
Box Office Mojo tracks worldwide box office and maintains a billion-dollar club as part of its releases data.
Avatar: Fire and Ash has worldwide gross of approximately $1.382 billion.
Avatar: Fire and Ash topped $1 billion worldwide by January 4, 2026.
Avatar: Fire and Ash reached $1 billion worldwide on its first weekend of 2026.
Avatar: Fire and Ash had a worldwide total around $1.475 billion as of February 28, 2026.
